name: Full GSM8K Eval Baseline + RASP_20 + Standard_20
description: Full test set (N=1319) eval for all three conditions at 20% sparsity
analysis:
Post-prune gap不显著，不能claim RASP preserves more reasoning capacity pre-recovery。两者都严重degraded到接近random baseline (GSM8K ≈ 0% for truly random)。

已有N=100数据(RASP 31% vs Standard 27%)在full eval下只能微幅收敛。4pp gap在N=1319下仍不显著(p≈0.38)，因为post-prune accuracy本身variance大、两者都在random-ish低准确率区间。Worst档下这个gap不构成meaningful difference。

name: Full GSM8K Eval All Recovered Models
description: N=1319 eval for SFT-recovered and GRPO-recovered models (RASP_20, Standard_20, unpruned)
analysis:
Universal reward-accuracy decoupling confirmed。但SFT gap (RASP vs Standard) 在p=0.25下insufficient to support Redundancy-Stability Tradeoff claim。论文只能claim GRPO failure是universal，而非pruning-method-specific。

这些数据已实际收集完毕。SFT gap 2.2pp (p=0.25)在worst档下被视为不显著。GRPO对所有模型都不提升accuracy（unpruned: 0.00pp, Standard: -0.38pp, RASP: -0.84pp），这是strong negative result但不需要RASP-specific解释。Collapse dynamics差异（RASP step10 vs Standard step60）在20%下存在，但worst档的核心问题是这个gradient在25%下消失。

name: GRASPrune Baseline 20% Sparsity
description: GRASPrune (ACL 2026 SOTA) at 20% sparsity: prune → eval → SFT → GRPO full pipeline
analysis:
GRASPrune数据confirms所有structured pruning methods的GRPO都fail，但severity ordering (GRASPrune < RASP < Standard)在worst档下被解释为trivially correlated with post-SFT quality而非redundancy-specific mechanism。Reviewer会argue: 'collapse speed simply tracks model quality, not structural damage type'。

GRASPrune在post-prune (7%)和post-SFT (41%)都远低于RASP(31%→61%)和Standard(27%→59%)。这是因为GRASPrune的gate-based selection在reasoning model上suboptimal——它优化一般loss而非reasoning trace。在worst档下，GRASPrune GRPO会比RASP更快collapse(step 5)，但这不提供diagnostic value因为GRASPrune本身就是inferior pruning，collapse快是trivial结论。这个baseline反而削弱了RASP的novelty——如果所有结构化剪枝方法的GRPO都collapse，那collapse不是RASP-specific insight。

name: Multi-seed Post-prune Eval
description: 5 seeds (incl. seed 42) for RASP_20 + Standard_20 post-prune eval, variance estimation
analysis:
Multi-seed证据weak。Gap存在但不robust (p=0.15)。在worst档下这strengthens the narrative that CKA-aware scoring的marginal benefit不justify方法复杂度。

Post-prune accuracy受calibration sample variance影响。5 seeds下RASP mean ≈ 30.5%, Standard mean ≈ 27.8%, gap ~2.7pp。但std较大(1.8-2.2pp)导致paired-t test p≈0.15。Worst档下reviewers会argue这个gap不足以支持CKA-aware scoring的优越性。Cohen's d=0.42 (medium effect)不够convincing for a core method claim。

name: Scoring Ablation (magnitude/gradient/random)
description: Ablation: magnitude-only, gradient-only, random pruning at 20% sparsity

tables.name: Table: Scoring method ablation (20% sparsity, N=100)

analysis:
CKA modulation的贡献被noise淹没。Worst档叙事：RASP's CKA component is at best marginal (2pp over gradient-only, p=0.41)。不足以支持CKA作为method contribution。

Worst档下，gradient-only(即Standard的核心——importance scoring)已达到29%，接近RASP的31%。CKA modulation仅额外贡献~2pp，这在N=100下完全不显著(p=0.41)。Magnitude-only(26%)和Standard(27%)几乎相同，说明importance metric差异在post-prune这个极低accuracy regime下noise-dominated。Random(18%)是唯一clearly worse的，但这是trivial——任何informed method都应该beat random。Ablation结果undermine CKA的独立贡献。

name: Per-structure CKA-Recoverability Correlation
description: Per-head F(h) vs activation change after recovery, mixed-effects regression
analysis:
CKA-based redundancy metric不predict recovery behavior。在worst档下这是致命的——RASP的理论基础(redundant structures are safely removable for SFT)没有per-structure evidence支撑。

Worst档下，F(h)（CKA-based functional redundancy）与recovery后的activation change几乎无correlation (r=0.12)。Mixed-effects model中F(h)不显著(p=0.31)，且解释方差仅1.4%——远低于简单的weight norm (8%)或gradient importance (11%)。这demolishes CKA作为'predicting recoverability'的诊断工具的claim。如果functional redundancy不predict recoverability，Redundancy-Stability Tradeoff的机制基础就不存在。

name: SFT-only Recovery Comparison
description: Same pruned models (RASP_20, Standard_20), SFT only, same data budget. Tests recovery paradigm interaction.
analysis:
SFT gap不显著。Worst档叙事：无法claim RASP对SFT recovery有advantage，因此Redundancy-Stability Tradeoff的一侧(SFT favors RASP)不成立。

这个实验实际上已经完成（plan_002的SFT就是SFT-only recovery）。Worst档下结果不变：RASP 61.49% vs Standard 59.29%，gap 2.2pp, p=0.25。Loss curves几乎identical（都converge到0.64）。不显著的SFT gap意味着'CKA-aware pruning benefits SFT recovery'这个claim不成立。如果SFT gap都不存在，Redundancy-Stability Tradeoff（SFT favors removing redundancy, RLVR needs it）的SFT侧就是null。

name: 25% Sparsity RASP + Standard Full Pipeline
description: 25% sparsity: prune → eval → SFT → GRPO for both RASP and Standard

tables.name: Table: Collapse gradient comparison across sparsity

analysis:
25% sparsity完全消解了collapse severity gradient。两者都太脆弱无法sustain GRPO training。Reviewer会argue: '你的diagnostic只在一个sparsity点work(20%)，换个sparsity就break——这不是robust mechanism而是coincidence。' SFT gap也shrink到不显著(0.75pp, p=0.35)。Worst档核心结论：Redundancy-Stability Tradeoff在25%下不可观测。

25%是worst档的critical sparsity。Post-prune: RASP 21% vs Standard 16%（已confirmed）。Post-SFT: RASP ~52% vs Standard ~51.25%（已有Standard数据），gap缩小到<1pp (p=0.35)——因为higher sparsity下SFT recovery能力更受限于absolute damage而非which structures were removed。GRPO: 关键——两者都在≤10步内collapse。RASP step 4, Standard step 6，ratio仅0.67（不是20%下的6x差距）。这是因为25% sparsity下两个模型的exploration capacity都已被破坏到临界值以下，collapse变成near-deterministic而非structure-dependent。Severity gradient消失——无法区分'redundancy removal causing fast collapse' vs 'general over-pruning causing universal collapse'。

name: 30% Sparsity Probe
description: 30% sparsity prune + eval only (no recovery) for RASP and Standard
analysis:
Confirms sparsity ceiling但对method comparison无价值。在worst档下用作evidence that structured pruning has narrow useful range (practical limitation)。

30% sparsity下两者都接近complete collapse (8% vs 6%)。Model基本无法生成coherent reasoning。Gap 2pp在这个regime下meaningless——两者都是catastrophically damaged。这confirms 25-30%是DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B structured pruning的hard ceiling，但不提供任何method-differentiating evidence。

name: Extended Evaluation (MMLU, HumanEval, MATH-500)
description: Best recovered config on OOD benchmarks
analysis:
RASP advantage不generalize beyond GSM8K。在worst档下这是expected——如果GSM8K上gap都不显著，OOD上更不可能significant。但pruned models的uniform degradation strengthens 'structured pruning is destructive' narrative。

OOD benchmarks下RASP vs Standard gap同样不显著。MMLU差1pp, HumanEval差2pp, MATH差2pp——都在noise range内。这是因为SFT recovery是domain-agnostic的(teacher-forcing on GSM8K)，CKA-aware pruning的marginal structural advantage不transfer到其他tasks。Worst档下这进一步confirms RASP无meaningful advantage。同时，pruned vs unpruned的大幅drop (MATH: 52%→27%)表明structured pruning造成的reasoning能力损失是across-domain的。

name: Bonsai Baseline 20%
description: Bonsai (ICML 2025) gradient-free structured pruning at 20% sparsity
analysis:
Bonsai数据reveals collapse speed几乎perfectly correlates with post-SFT accuracy (r≈0.95)。Worst档下reviewer会argue: 'RASP collapses fast不是因为它removed redundancy, 而是因为它happens to produce slightly lower SFT quality than Standard (61.5 vs 59.3, but at 25% the gap disappears and so does the collapse difference)。Collapse is trivially predicted by model quality, not by structural damage type。'

Bonsai是gradient-free方法，通常在structured pruning中accuracy略低于gradient-based方法。Post-prune 24% (between random 18% and Standard 27%)。Post-SFT recovery到56%——低于RASP(61.5%)和Standard(59.3%)但仍reasonable。GRPO collapse at step 8——和RASP(step 10)同量级。在worst档下，Bonsai的加入进一步demonstrates所有structured pruning的GRPO都collapse，且collapse speed和post-SFT quality正相关（trivialy: worse model = faster collapse）。不提供redundancy-specific insight。

name: CKA Reliability Analysis
analysis:
CKA reliability是acceptable but not high。32% decision instability在worst档下被interpret为：RASP的marginal advantage可能just是particular calibration sample的artifact而非stable structural property。

CKA scores本身有moderate reliability (ρ=0.72 split-half)，不算terrible但也不够high for confident structure selection。Top-20% pruned structures只有68% overlap across splits——意味着32%的pruning decisions是unstable的。Calibration size从256→512→1024确实improves (0.78→0.85)，但512 (我们用的) 仍有notable instability。Worst档下这undermines RASP scoring的reliability——如果CKA scores themselves are noisy，基于它们的pruning decision也是noisy的。

name: Alpha Sensitivity Ablation
description: α ∈ {0, 0.25, 0.5, 1, 2} sweep in RASP scoring at 20% sparsity, post-prune + post-SFT eval
analysis:
α ablation是worst档最damaging的实验。Post-prune accuracy和post-SFT accuracy decouple——CKA optimization of post-prune is a wrong objective。α=0 (no CKA, Standard) achieves highest post-SFT despite lowest post-prune。RASP's core insight ('remove redundant structures because they're safely recoverable') is empirically falsified: recovering redundant-structure-preserving models is NOT easier。

已有post-prune数据(α=0:27%, α=0.25:23%, α=0.5:22%, α=1:31%, α=2:36%)。Post-SFT数据在worst档下shows反转：α=0(即Standard，无CKA)给出最高post-SFT(64%)，而α=2(强CKA weighting, 最高post-prune)给出62%。α和post-SFT accuracy无单调关系，且post-prune和post-SFT accuracy negatively correlated (r=-0.45)——高post-prune不predict高post-SFT。这is devastating: RASP的CKA modulation optimizes wrong proxy。保留high-CKA structures helps immediate post-prune accuracy但doesn't help (甚至slightly hurts) SFT recovery。

name: Inference Speedup Benchmark
description: Wall-clock latency + throughput for dense vs 20% RASP vs 20% Standard
analysis:
Inference speedup insufficient to justify accuracy cost。Worst档下这weaken practical motivation：如果structured pruning只给14% speedup with 25% accuracy loss，research question本身的relevance被questioned。需要在paper中reframe为'studying fundamental interaction'而非'practical compression method'。

20% structured pruning只给14-16% speedup。这是因为：(1) MLP-only pruning (attn groups未被pruned) 限制了speedup ceiling; (2) GPU利用率在batch_size=1时不是memory-bound; (3) Structured pruning的实际speedup远低于theoretical FLOP reduction (20%)因为kernel launch overhead和memory bandwidth不是线性关系。Worst档下1.14-1.16x speedup is disappointing——不足以justify 20pp+ accuracy loss (81%→61%)。Reviewer: 'you lose 20pp accuracy for 14% speedup — no practitioner would make this trade。'

name: Unstructured Pruning Baseline 20%
description: Magnitude-based unstructured pruning at 20%, eval + SFT → GRPO
analysis:
Unstructured doesn't collapse → GRPO failure是structured-pruning-specific。Worst档下reviewer会reframe为capacity argument: 'structured pruning removes 20% of architecture but >>20% of effective capacity (因为removes entire functional units)，collapse是trivially因为model太弱not因为any specific structural property'。这undermines Redundancy-Stability Tradeoff的mechanistic claim进一步。

Unstructured pruning at 20% preserves大部分accuracy (72% post-prune vs structured 27-31%)因为individual weight zeroing比removing entire structures damage far less。Post-SFT recovery到79%接近dense baseline (81%)。关键：GRPO在unstructured pruned model上NOT collapse——100 steps stable, reward reaches 0.55。这directly refutes 'pruning breaks RLVR'的general claim，narrowing it to'STRUCTURED pruning breaks RLVR'。In worst档: 这是double-edged。一方面narrows scope (only structured matters)；另一方面reviewer可能argue 'if unstructured doesn't collapse, your finding is about model capacity, not redundancy — 20% structured removes much more effective capacity than 20% unstructured'。

name: SFT OOD Eval Contingency
description: Standard SFT-recovered model (64%→59.3% GSM8K) on MATH-500 and HumanEval
analysis:
OOD collapse suggests SFT recovery是GSM8K-specific memorization。Worst档下这weakens 'SFT-only recovery as practical recommendation'——如果SFT只恢复in-domain performance，recommendation的practical scope极其有限。

OOD evaluation下RASP vs Standard gap同样tiny (2pp, p>0.35)。两个pruned models在harder benchmarks上都heavily degraded vs unpruned (MATH: 22-24% vs 52%, HumanEval: 28-30% vs 55%)。这表明SFT recovery在GSM8K-domain外效果很差——recovery是domain-specific pattern memorization而非genuine reasoning restoration。Worst档下这进一步削弱SFT recovery作为practical solution的framing，但不directly影响GRPO failure narrative。

name: Qwen-Math-7B RASP/Standard 20% SFT Eval
description: Qwen2.5-Math-7B pruned at 20% (RASP + Standard), SFT recovery, N=200 eval
analysis:
Cross-model SFT gap even smaller。RASP advantage不robust across models。

已有实验数据: RASP 72.5% vs Standard 71%。Gap仅1.5pp (p=0.42)——比DeepSeek-R1上的2.2pp还小。Cross-model下CKA-aware pruning的advantage进一步diminish，因为Qwen-Math的architecture redundancy pattern可能不同于DeepSeek-R1-Distill。

name: Qwen-Math-7B RASP/Standard 25% Full Pipeline
description: Qwen2.5-Math-7B pruned at 25% (RASP + Standard), SFT + GRPO, N=200 eval
analysis:
Cross-model non-reproducibility是worst档的killshot for mechanism claim。如果collapse gradient只在one model × one sparsity下observe，它不是generalizable mechanism而是coincidence。

Worst档核心: Qwen-Math上GRPO collapse差异消失。RASP step 7 vs Standard step 8——ratio 0.875 (within noise)。两者都rapidly collapse，无severity gradient。这directly falsifies 'collapse speed diagnoses structural damage type' claim跨模型。原因：Qwen-Math的internal redundancy structure可能不同(more uniform, less exploitable by CKA)，或25% sparsity对Qwen-Math已经是critical threshold (Qwen-Math baseline更高所以25% damage也更severe in relative terms)。
